crossRefs.note: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
“Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth…

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

translations.web: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
translations.bsb: And the donkey saw the angel of the LORD and pressed herself against the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat her once again.
translations.kjv: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
translations.asv: And the ass saw the angel of Jehovah, and she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
